video_title: Did the Knicks get LUCKY and can they actually go back to back 👀

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's arrival impacts the Knicks' team chemistry
quotes.excerpt: if you're going into the season with this Jalen Brunson shit, that can fuck up a little chemistry
quotes.quote: If you're going into the season with this Jalen Brunson shit, that can fuck up a little chemistry. You lost Isaiah Hartenstein, you lost your bruiser, you lost your enforcer.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks will not get past the Indiana Pacers
quotes.excerpt: The Knicks were not going to get past Indiana. You know that. We've seen it before.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: You know the Knicks were not going to get past Indiana. You know that. We've seen it before.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Our kryptonite, whether we were playing Indiana or Miami, was Tom Thibodeau. Once we got him out of there, we knew we could beat everybody.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' success is built on positive experience, not just luck
quotes.excerpt: People only believe that losing is experience. We just won a chip. The year before that was Eastern Conference Finals.
quotes.quote: People only believe that losing is experience. We just won a chip. The year before that was Eastern Conference Finals. Now we're just going to continue to roll this gravy train. We're going to have to lose before I say and pick and be an analyst and say, 'Oh, Indiana might upset us.' No, you're going to have to show me that you can stop Jalen Brunson. That's Alan Iverson from the left side of the court. If AI had a team, this is what it would look like.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks and Pacers are essentially the same tier of team
quotes.excerpt: I think they're essentially the same team.
quotes.quote: I think they're essentially the same team.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Drummond brings a different dynamic than Mitchell Robinson
quotes.excerpt: Drummond brings a different dynamic than Mitchell Robinson brings. Drummond can actually guard pick and roll.
quotes.quote: Drummond brings a different dynamic than Mitchell Robinson brings. Drummond can actually guard pick and roll. He can actually get in the pass lane and get steals. He's a capable free throw shooter now, right? So it's just things like that.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson is the X-factor for the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: Obviously the main guy is Jalen Brunson. I think he is the X-factor for that team.
quotes.quote: Obviously the main guy is Jalen Brunson. I think he is the X-factor for that team. All big games, he showed up. Think about them threes he was making in the corner in one of the last games with the Spurs. Contested threes, falling down, getting the tip-in. He's a capable free throw shooter now.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Caris LeVert's emergence in Cleveland is a major development
quotes.excerpt: with the emergence of Caris LeVert in that Cleveland series, oh my god, that boy.
quotes.quote: With the emergence of Caris LeVert in that Cleveland series, oh my god, that boy. And they were able to retain him. It's going to be very hard to repeat because we all know how hard it is to repeat. It's not an easy thing to do because you've got to fight the complacency, you've got to fight the 'I did it already'.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Teams fear a role-playing Andre Drummond more than a superstar
quotes.excerpt: I fear a role playing Drummond rather than a superstar focal point Drummond.
quotes.quote: I fear a role playing Drummond rather than a superstar focal point Drummond. That's a big fear. A big fear. And his plus-minus is probably going to be astronomical.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks had a championship-or-bust year due to injuries
quotes.excerpt: We said at the beginning of the year if the Knicks want to win a championship, it had to be this year.
quotes.quote: We said at the beginning of the year if the Knicks want to win a championship, it had to be this year. Because you had Tyrese Haliburton hurt and the Pacers who they were giving everybody hell, and then you had Jason Tatum not being healthy and we didn't know what Boston was going to look like. And then you had no one believed in Philly. There was no really other team that you really feared.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: The era of dynasty teams in the NBA is over
quotes.excerpt: There's not no more, there's no more dynasty teams. I think the last dynasty team was the Golden State Warriors.
quotes.quote: There's not no more, there's no more dynasty teams. I think the last dynasty team was the Golden State Warriors.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's growth into a superstar is Knicks' path to success
quotes.excerpt: You get better with experience. The way y'all sitting here giving OG all this credit, now OG might believe, 'Hey man, I really might be one of the best players in this league.' That's your team getting better with one of your players growing into that role.
quotes.quote: You get better with experience. The way y'all sitting here giving OG all this credit, now OG might believe, 'Hey man, I really might be one of the best players in this league.' That's your team getting better with one of your players growing into that role. That's what I feel he's doing. Cat, you know we won a chip. Cat had two points in game five. Two points. And this is why I give Jalen Brunson all the credit I give him because you can't score two points, Jalen, and we win. Your name is Michael Jalen Brunson, and this is the dynasty right here.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: San Antonio Spurs have the potential to build a dynasty
quotes.excerpt: Don't you think the San Antonio Spurs can carry that same mentality?
quotes.quote: Don't you think the San Antonio Spurs can carry that same mentality? Like, man, we got this close being fucking so young. Shit, let's get better. And they got better. The Spurs got so much better.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' core players are all in their prime
quotes.excerpt: Everybody y'all named though got some type of weakness. If you're talking about Philly as far as players in history, they don't have no weakness.
quotes.quote: Everybody y'all named though got some type of weakness. If you're talking about Philly as far as players in history, they don't have no weakness. But when you go to the facts of somebody being 45, somebody's always hurt, somebody's a rookie damn near, it's like you got that stuff. We got all these players in their prime. They're absolute prime.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' window for a championship is very short
quotes.excerpt: The Knicks window to win another championship is very short.
quotes.quote: The Knicks window to win another championship is very short. And that's the bad point when you talk about the Spurs. Because the Spurs window is a lot bigger than the Knicks. I tell you that, pause.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Oklahoma City Thunder have a similar team structure to last year
quotes.excerpt: Oklahoma City has the same team as last year.
quotes.quote: Oklahoma City has the same team as last year.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' core is older and more experienced than OKC's
quotes.excerpt: We're talking about 29, 30-year-olds like you develop, you went through literally everything.
quotes.quote: We're talking about 29, 30-year-olds like you develop, you went through literally everything. Oklahoma City showed their youth. Oklahoma City still had their immaturities as you saw last year.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: OG Anunoby and Mikal Bridges are the highest-paid Knicks
quotes.excerpt: OG is second, he's after Carl.
quotes.quote: OG is second, he's after Carl.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks face difficult financial decisions with upcoming contracts
quotes.excerpt: You have to pay Carl and you have to pay Jalen.
quotes.quote: You have to pay Carl and you have to pay Jalen. And Jalen is priority.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' flexibility decreases as they pay their core players
quotes.excerpt: Every single year the flexibility leaves.
quotes.quote: Every single year the flexibility leaves.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks should prioritize paying their current core players
quotes.excerpt: It's best to pay the guys that you already have because that does not count.
quotes.quote: It's best to pay the guys that you already have because that does not count. They have the money, it's the restrictions of the aprons which really hurts them.
